name: x402 payments
description: Pay per call for x402 paid APIs in USDC from a small wallet you dedicate to it, with a person's approval every time and hard per-call and daily limits (x402_quote, x402_fetch, x402_wallet).
notice: This pack signs real USDC payments from the wallet whose private key you store as X402_PRIVATE_KEY. Use a new wallet that holds only a few dollars, never your main one: anyone who gets that key can spend what is on it. Every payment asks you to approve it first, is capped by max_usd, the per-call limit and the 24-hour limit below, and is logged in the pack's data folder. Payments on chain cannot be reversed. Start on Base Sepolia (testnet USDC, free from a faucet) to try it.

secrets.name: X402_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.label: x402 wallet private key (a small, dedicated wallet)

allowedNetworks.title: Allowed networks
allowedNetworks.description: CAIP-2 ids of the chains the wallet may pay on, in USDC only: eip155:8453 (Base), eip155:84532 (Base Sepolia testnet), eip155:1 (Ethereum), eip155:137 (Polygon), eip155:42161 (Arbitrum), eip155:10 (OP Mainnet), eip155:43114 (Avalanche). Default Base and Base Sepolia.

maxPerCallUsd.title: Most per payment (USD)
maxPerCallUsd.description: No single payment can be above this, whatever max_usd a call asks for. Default 0.10, at most 25.

dailyCapUsd.title: Most per 24 hours (USD)
dailyCapUsd.description: Total that may be signed in any rolling 24 hours. Every signed payment counts, even one the server then refuses. Default 1, at most 250.

allowedHosts.title: Allowed hosts
allowedHosts.description: Optional: only pay these hosts (api.example.com or *.example.com). Empty means any https host, but x402_quote then sends no extra headers.
